correctness.rationale: Union multiplicity identity 2t+b12+b13+b23=2s is exact. Inclusion-exclusion writes R=1-3q^d+sum_{pairs}q^{2d-|Ai intersection Aj|}-q^m. Strict convexity of r^x with r=1/q>1 concentrates pair-only overlaps into one pair, reducing the upper bound to f(t)=r^(2s-t)+2r^t. Its strict convexity in t places its maximum exclusively at 0 or s; both endpoint set systems are feasible because d>=2s and equality cases are unique up to guild relabeling. Factoring endpoint gap gives a single crossing, with no endpoint error q in (0,1). Independent exhaustive 4-pollinator failure-state enumeration gave (225/256,219/256) at q=1/4 and (49/256,67/256) at q=3/4 for paired/common; script and limited all-set enumeration inspected, finite evidence only.

value.rationale: An analytically sharp structure switch in a natural fixed-connectance robustness problem is substantive: individual support means and union-presence probabilities are constant across all eligible incidence networks, whereas simultaneous plant support is sensitive to incidence architecture. It also demonstrates a disconnected optimal topology under allowed assumptions.

final_claim: Among all three equal-degree-d plant incidence networks on m=3d-2s fully used pollinators, d>=2s,s>=1, under iid Bernoulli pollinator failure probability q, the optimal all-plant support network is paired-module for q<2^(-1/s), shared-core for q>2^(-1/s), both and only both at equality. Gap q^(2d-2s)(1-q^s)(1-2q^s).
